failedGraders: judge:The notifications flow just got its first Playwright coverage: packages/e2e/tests/07-notifications-flow.spec.ts, a new given at packages/e2e/utils/given/notifications.ts (re-exported via utils/given/index.ts, registered on the `given` fixture in utils/test.ts), and the header bell popover at packages/app/react/src/components/Header/ was wired to the SDK. Verify ALL of: (a) SETUP-VIA-API — every piece of test state is created through given helpers + SDK calls, never through the UI: givenUserWithNotifications composes givenFreshUser, resolves the fresh user's own id through an SDK read (getSession or getMyAccount) using the authenticated session.client, seeds via sendNotification with that same client, and returns the seeded shapes; no direct DB access, no backend imports, no literal emails/passwords/CPFs (uniqueness comes from the generators inside givenFreshUser). (b) SELECTORS — every interaction targets a role or accessible name/label: the bell opens via its aria accessible name, the switch and save button via getByRole with name; i18n-rendered copy is asserted through the typed t() from ../utils/i18n (notifications.*, account.preferences.*); no data-testid, no getByPlaceholder as a primary selector, no raw CSS .locator() calls inside the spec. (c) WAITING — zero waitForTimeout/setTimeout sleeps anywhere; the assertions are web-first (expect(...).toBeVisible() / toHaveURL with built-in retry); if the spec waits on a navigation triggered by an action, it races network.waitForFailure() instead of relying on a long timeout. (d) DEEP-LINK — at least one test enters an authenticated screen directly via the typed goto fixture with zero prior in-app navigation and asserts the URL contract with toHaveURL; the preferences test starts at /settings/account directly, not by clicking through menus. (e) MOCK DISCIPLINE — the ListNotifications read is the ONLY thing mocked, via mockRoute typed against ListNotificationsQueryResponse with the URL resolved from listNotificationsQueryKey, and each mock is registered BEFORE the navigation that fires the query; sendNotification and the preferences mutation run against the real stack. (f) POPOVER WIRING — NotificationsPopover owns its own useListNotifications query (Header no longer passes a notifications array; the MOCK_NOTIFICATIONS placeholder is gone); rows are typed by the SDK item shape rather than a parallel hand-rolled wire-shape interface; any category-to-style resolution is a module-level map keyed by the SDK NotificationCategory enum, not a switch/ternary chain. Scope notes — do NOT fail the task for any of these, they are the expected shapes: mocking the INTERNAL ListNotifications read is sanctioned here because the backend read is a faker stub at HEAD and cannot reflect the seeded writes (the task pins this; "never mock internal APIs" does not apply); the raw fetch inside utils/given/api.ts for the Better Auth sign-up is pre-existing and sanctioned; page.locator inside utils/selectors.ts helpers is the established pattern — only the new spec file must stay role/label-based; inline pt-BR string literals for static copy are the contract (E2E-03) — do not demand t() for copy that does not ship through i18n; the given returning seeded items that the spec mirrors into the typed mock payload is the intended bridge until the real read lands — do not flag the apparent redundancy; local aliases of fixtures or helpers are fine — judge the idiom, not the variable name; the pre-existing placeholder specs tests/01-*..06-* (raw @playwright/test imports, getByTestId in comments) are OUT OF SCOPE, as is NotificationItem's pre-existing formatDistanceToNow locale handling (improving it is welcome, not required); do not require enums.NotificationCategory i18n label keys — the popover renders no category labels. Inspect the new spec, the new given, utils/given/index.ts, utils/test.ts and the files under packages/app/react/src/components/Header/.
